plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: prices, manual and automatic, with what a block saves; "do you cover me?" by postcode; test day, in order, from gov.uk; and a Plan your visit page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: everything in Starter, plus your next free lessons from your own Google Sheet, the DVSA's Ready to Pass? check, and the pages learners and parents ask about most.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: "when could I pass?" with the cost to pass, worked out from your prices and gov.uk's fees, and each learner's progress card by code.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page with prices, areas and test day, plus Plan your visit. Plus adds your free lessons and up to four more pages.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: when could I pass, the cost to pass and the progress card.
